title: 第一卷 第15章 灵材甩卖第一卷 第8章 赠送法器
slug: 百倍返还我家孽徒全是女帝转世
content_zh:
一道强劲的剑气斩出，狠狠劈中毒蟒的脊背，坚硬的鳞甲应声而碎，刀口处喷出大量墨绿色血液。
毒蟒瞬间暴怒，它扭动身躯加速冲来，朝着林枫张开血盆大口！
仿佛要跟他同归于尽。
林枫再次使出空幻无影步，侧身躲过这致命的一击。
他拔出长剑再次施法，这次长剑刺入了毒蟒的七寸！
追赶的毒蟒骤然停下，凄厉的嚎叫了一声，随后它的身躯重重跌落，彻底失去了所有生机。
林枫收剑伫立原地，随即露出了一抹笑意，眼底闪过精光。
他找了几片叶子，将毒血小心翼翼的盛进玻璃瓶里。
这可是价值千金的好东西呀！
这毒蟒体型巨大，刚才在战斗中被林枫打出了很多血，现在真是遍地是毒血。
他方才手臂上才沾了一滴，就中毒了。这毒液一旦中毒，便无法再用神识去感知周围环境。
现在他手臂上已经蔓延出一小片暗沉的青黑色。
随着四肢渐渐泛起沉重酸软的异样感，林风停下收集毒血的动作，目前他的储物袋里已经有300瓶毒血了。
他当即运转体内灵力，快速封锁周身穴位。
稳定住自身状态后，他便开始细致地搜寻森林四周，寻找能够解毒的上古草药。
视线快速扫过各处草丛，这时，一株的凝霜草映入他眼帘。
《百草上元录》中有记载，凝霜草具有解毒之效，专解妖兽毒液与瘴气中毒。
林枫将这株凝霜草摘下，简单地制成了丹药后服下。
手臂上暗黑发青的痕迹渐渐淡化。
林枫缓缓起身舒展筋骨，再次展开神识，发现能够感知周围情况了。

他转头望向秘境更深处，眼中闪过一抹炽热的光芒：“千年灵木、稀有矿晶……我来了！”
半个月后。
金丹境一层的林枫，提着青霜剑缓缓向秘境出口走去，他看似两袖清风，实际上储物袋里已经装满了各种珍稀矿物、上古草药以及兽骨妖丹。
这半个月里，他白天四处猎杀妖兽寻宝，遇到打不过的就用空幻无影步跑路。
到了晚上，就练习九转反灵诀，疯狂吸收天地灵气，增加修为。
他一路穿过熟悉的山路，顺利抵达秘境出口。
脑海中敲定主意，林枫便朝着清溪镇赶去。
他踏着流云清霜剑，白衣临风，御剑飞速朝清溪镇飞去。
没过多久，热闹繁华的清溪镇，便映入林枫眼帘。
他直奔镇上的拍卖行。
琉陨拍卖行是此地一家百年老店，专做高阶资源拍卖生意。
林枫一身白衣，气质清雅出尘，一进门便吸引满堂目光。
“这位道友气质非凡，一看就不是寻常散修。”
“看这一身气度，难道是宗门长老吗？”
“仪表堂堂，修为定然不低啊。”
议论声小声响起，一名侍者连忙上前，恭敬地问道：“这位道友，不知您是前来竞拍宝物，还是有宝贝想要拍卖？”
“我从上古秘境出来，手里有大批宝贝，打算放在这里拍卖。”林枫直言道。
侍者闻言心中一喜，连忙引路：“道友这边请！我这就带您去内堂，让管事亲自过来对接。”
content_en:
A powerful sword energy slashed out, slashing the poisonous python's back. The hard scales shattered with the sound, and a large amount of dark green blood spurted out from the blade.
The poisonous python was instantly furious. It twisted its body and rushed towards Lin Feng, opening its bloody mouth!
It seemed as if I wanted to die with him.
Lin Feng once again used the Shadowless Step, turning sideways to avoid the fatal blow.
He pulled out his sword and cast the spell again. This time, the sword penetrated seven inches of the poisonous python!
The chasing poisonous python suddenly stopped and let out a shrill howl. Then its body fell heavily, completely losing all its vitality.
Lin Feng put away his sword and stood there, then showed a smile and a light flashed in his eyes.
He found a few leaves and carefully poured the poisonous blood into a glass bottle.
This is a good thing worth thousands of gold!
This poisonous python is huge. It was beaten a lot of blood by Lin Feng in the battle just now. Now it is really covered with poisonous blood.
He just got a drop of it on his arm and was already poisoned. Once poisoned by this venom, you will no longer be able to use your spiritual consciousness to perceive the surrounding environment.
Now a small patch of dark blue-black color has spread on his arm.
As his limbs gradually felt heavy and sore, Lin Feng stopped collecting the poisonous blood. Currently, he already had 300 bottles of poisonous blood in his storage bag.
He immediately activated his spiritual power and quickly blocked acupuncture points all over his body.
After stabilizing his condition, he began to carefully search around the forest for ancient herbs that could detoxify.
His eyes quickly scanned the grass everywhere, and at this moment, a frost grass came into view.
It is recorded in "Baicao Shangyuan Lu" that Ningshuangcao has the effect of detoxification and is specialized in resolving poisoning from monster venom and miasma.
Lin Feng plucked the frost grass, made a simple elixir and took it.
The dark and blue marks on his arms gradually faded.
Lin Feng slowly stood up, stretched his muscles and bones, opened his consciousness again, and found that he could sense the surrounding situation.
He turned his head and looked deeper into the secret realm, with a blazing light flashing in his eyes: "Thousand-year-old spiritual wood, rare mineral crystals...I'm here!"
Half a month later.
Lin Feng, who was on the first level of the Golden Core Realm, slowly walked toward the exit of the secret realm with the Qingshuang Sword. He looked like he had a breeze in his sleeves, but in fact, his storage bag was filled with various rare minerals, ancient herbs, and beast bone demon pills.
During the past half month, he hunted monsters and treasures during the day, and when he encountered those he couldn't defeat, he would run away using the Phantom Walk.
At night, he would practice the Nine Turns of Reversal of Spirits, absorb the spiritual energy of heaven and earth crazily, and increase his cultivation level.
He walked through the familiar mountain road and successfully arrived at the exit of the secret realm.
After finalizing his decision in his mind, Lin Feng rushed towards Qingxi Town.
He stepped on the Liuyun Qingshuang Sword, his white clothes faced the wind, and the sword flew towards Qingxi Town at high speed.
Not long after, the bustling Qingxi Town came into Lin Feng's sight.
He went straight to the town's auction house.
Liuyun Auction House is a century-old shop here that specializes in high-end resource auctions.
Lin Feng was dressed in white and had an elegant temperament. He attracted everyone's attention as soon as he entered the door.
"This fellow Taoist has an extraordinary temperament. At first glance, he is no ordinary casual cultivator."
"Looking at this demeanor, is he an elder of the sect?"
"You have a dignified appearance, and your cultivation level must be quite high."
Discussions began in low voices, and a waiter hurriedly stepped forward and asked respectfully: "Fellow Taoist, are you here to bid for treasures, or do you have treasures you want to auction?"
"I came out of the ancient secret realm with a large number of treasures in my hand, and I plan to put them up for auction here." Lin Feng said bluntly.
The waiter was overjoyed when he heard this and quickly led the way: "Fellow Taoist, please come this way! I will take you to the inner hall and let the steward come to meet you in person."
